description: This file implements the DefaultOptionsFormatter class, which provides functionality to format and redact configuration options of generic type T for Orleans, using reflection to inspect properties and handle special attributes such as Obsolete and Redact.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>
classes.description: Provides formatting for options of type T, including redaction and property inspection.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsFormatterResolver<T>
classes.description: Resolves a formatter for options of type T based on options monitor.

methods.description: Formats the properties of the options object into enumerable strings.

methods.description: Checks if a method is publicly accessible and not obsolete.
